sentences.en: Brokers made a killing because of the high yen.
sentences.zh: 由于日元汇率高，经纪人赚了一大笔钱。

sentences.en: The real estate broker was lavish in his spending in Ginza.
sentences.zh: 房地产经纪人在银座花钱如流水。

sentences.en: Brokers struggling to make a profit don't always play by the book.
sentences.zh: 努力赚钱却难以获利的经纪人并不总是循规蹈矩。
